maddeler.e:
أبتده (form VIII)
# أَبْتَدِهُ (ʔabtadihu) /ʔab.ta.di.hu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# أُبْتَدَهُ (ʔubtadahu) /ʔub.ta.da.hu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# أَبْتَدِهَ (ʔabtadiha) /ʔab.ta.di.ha/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# أُبْتَدَهَ (ʔubtadaha) /ʔub.ta.da
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
